role: Independent archive and record-consistency review; no tests or workers executed.

comparison.testcase_identity: Exact unique (classname, name) pairs including parameter IDs from original JUnit. No normalization or filtering.

archive.method: Only the 100 JSON paths explicitly declared by HOLDOUT_REPORTS, CPU_RECOVERY_REPORTS and ACCEPTANCE_REPORTS were passed to tar. Exactly one member per original path; same-path inconsistent size/SHA would abort. Both runs have 50 references (6+40+4), no duplicates.

tar_command_construction.trailing_arguments: manifest.archive.entries[].member in recorded sorted order; original absolute path minus its leading slash.
tar_command_construction.shell_quoting: Each file argument single-quoted with embedded single quote encoded as '\''.
tar_command_construction.note: This describes the exact executed command without repeating its 100 paths. All arguments and byte hashes are preserved in manifest.

verification.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import collections,hashlib,json,re,tarfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('docs/evidence/runs/2026-09-12-autonomy-full-reports');manifest=json.loads((base/'manifest.json').read_text());entries=manifest['archive']['entries'];by_member={x['member']:x for x in entries};assert len(by_member)==len(entries)==100
refs=[];cases={};verified={};dec=json.JSONDecoder()
for epoch in ['cephfs','ext4']:
 ep=manifest['epochs'][epoch];rp=Path(ep['report']['path']);raw=rp.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==ep['report']['sha256'];assert len(raw)==ep['report']['bytes'];report=json.loads(raw)
 stdout=''.join(x['output'] for x in report['raw_tool_results']).encode();lp=Path(manifest['raw_logs'][epoch]);assert lp.read_bytes()==stdout;assert hashlib.sha256(stdout).hexdigest()==ep['stdout']['sha256']
 for marker in ['HOLDOUT_REPORTS','CPU_RECOVERY_REPORTS','ACCEPTANCE_REPORTS']:
  ms=list(re.finditer(re.escape(marker)+'=',stdout.decode()));assert len(ms)==1
  values,end=dec.raw_decode(stdout.decode()[ms[0].end():]);assert len(values)==ep['markers'][marker]
  refs.extend({'epoch':epoch,'marker':marker,'ordinal':i,'declared':v} for i,v in enumerate(values))
 jp=Path(ep['junit']['path']);jr=jp.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(jr).hexdigest()==ep['junit']['sha256'];assert jr==Path(ep['junit']['original']).read_bytes();tree=ET.fromstring(jr);ns=tree.findall('.//testcase');keys={}
 for n in ns:
  k=(n.attrib.get('classname',''),n.attrib['name']);assert k not in keys
  outcomes=[t for t in ['failure','error','skipped'] if n.find(t) is not None];assert len(outcomes)<=1;keys[k]=outcomes[0] if outcomes else 'passed'
 assert len(keys)==4563;assert dict(collections.Counter(keys.values()))==ep['junit']['counts'];cases[epoch]=keys
 verified[epoch]={'testcases':len(keys),'counts':dict(collections.Counter(keys.values())),'junit_sha256':hashlib.sha256(jr).hexdigest(),'stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(stdout).hexdigest(),'report_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'marker_counts':ep['markers']}
flatten=[y for x in entries for y in x['occurrences']];key=lambda x:(x['epoch'],x['marker'],x['ordinal']);assert sorted(refs,key=key)==sorted(flatten,key=key)
assert cases['cephfs'].keys()==cases['ext4'].keys();changed=[{'classname':k[0],'name':k[1],'before':v,'after':cases['ext4'][k]} for k,v in cases['cephfs'].items() if v!=cases['ext4'][k]];assert len(changed)==97;assert all(x['before']=='failure' and x['after']=='passed' for x in changed);assert sorted(changed,key=lambda x:(x['classname'],x['name']))==sorted(manifest['comparison']['failed_then_passed'],key=lambda x:(x['classname'],x['name']))
unique_paths=set();total=0
with tarfile.open(base/'reports.tar.gz','r:gz') as tar:
 members=tar.getmembers();assert len(members)==100;assert len({x.name for x in members})==100;assert {x.name for x in members}==set(by_member)
 for member in members:
  entry=by_member[member.name];assert member.isfile() and not member.name.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(member.name).parts
  data=tar.extractfile(member).read();assert len(data)==entry['bytes']==member.size;assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==entry['sha256'];assert data==Path(entry['original']).read_bytes();json.loads(data);unique_paths.add(entry['original']);total+=len(data)
assert len(unique_paths)==100 and total==20097880
files={str(p):{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in sorted(base.iterdir()) if p.is_file()}
print(json.dumps({'all_exact':True,'epochs':verified,'testcase_keysets_equal':True,'failed_then_passed':len(changed),'unchanged_passes':4459,'unchanged_skips':7,'archive_members':100,'marker_references':len(refs),'duplicates_deduplicated':len(refs)-len(unique_paths),'report_json_bytes':total,'files':files},sort_keys=True))
PY
